## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(None directly — infrastructure RED-test task. DD-3 script behavior is owned by task-4b, which makes this test pass; SKILL wiring half of dd-3 is owned by task-5b.)

Create tests/scripts/test-run-hermetic.sh asserting the not-yet-existing helper's contract: (1) a shell test (.sh suffix) that reproduces under hermetic isolation → exit 0 with reproduction confirmed; (2) a shell test that does NOT reproduce → exit non-zero so the caller can trigger the HARD-GATE full stop; (3) a non-shell test (resolved $TEST_CMD runner is not bash|sh and no .sh suffix) → emits 'HERMETIC_SKIP: runner=<runner> reason=non-shell' and exits 0 (never blocked); (4) shell-ness is determined iff .sh suffix OR the resolved $TEST_CMD runner starts with bash|sh. The test MUST fail now because plugins/dso/scripts/run-hermetic.sh does not yet exist. Set the executable bit on the new test file.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] New test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-run-hermetic.sh
- [ ] Test is RED now (fails because helper is absent) — Verify: ! bash tests/scripts/test-run-hermetic.sh
- [ ] Test asserts the reproduce/non-reproduce shell branches, the HERMETIC_SKIP non-shell path, and the .sh-suffix-OR-bash|sh-runner shell determination — Verify: for t in HERMETIC_SKIP non-shell reproduce 'bash|sh'; do grep -qE "$t" tests/scripts/test-run-hermetic.sh || { echo MISSING:$t; exit 1; }; done

## TDD Test Approach
Given a non-reproducing shell (.sh) RED test passed to the helper; When tests/scripts/test-run-hermetic.sh invokes plugins/dso/scripts/run-hermetic.sh on it; Then the helper exits non-zero (signalling the caller to HARD-GATE full stop) — and the test currently FAILS because run-hermetic.sh does not yet exist.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
